# ue-perf-probe-toolset

> Pure core and unreal adapter of an Unreal MCP toolset that records CSV Profiler captures, computes frame statistics against budgets and reports build size. Python package `trysac-ue-perf-probe-toolset`, import name `ue_perf_probe_toolset`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
